overloads.semanticRole: Inserts one or more rows into the table intersecting a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document.

discriminatedBy.note: targetObj resolved to the first intersecting table; command does nothing (returns Null, no error) if no table/text range intersects

overloads.semanticRole: Inserts one or more rows into a specific table at a given row index, addressed by table reference.

discriminatedBy.note: 2-3 arg form addressing a table by reference plus explicit row index

constraints: If rowNumber is higher than the number of rows in tableRef, the rows are appended rather than inserted.
Returns a row range representing the inserted row(s), or Null if nothing was inserted.
